author: Tobias Ellinghaus, Christian Mandel
name: import_filters
description: Adds import filters that either skip all JPEGs or ignore JPEGs only when a matching non-JPEG file exists during import.
description-extensive: This tool gives you extra choices for which files get brought in when you import photos. One option skips all JPEGs, while a smarter option ignores a JPEG only when there is a matching RAW file with the same name, so you keep standalone JPEGs but avoid duplicates. It requires the companion import filter manager script and needs no other software.
